name: The Attic Encampment
description: A settlement in the attic that sheltered Dawn and is wiped out in an attack.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Dawn wakes screaming in the attic encampment, annoying the guards.
timeline.quote: Dawn woke up screaming, kicking off the thin blanket

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Dawn recalls how she found an unguarded tunnel to the attic and warned its leads before monsters attacked the carnival's doors.
timeline.quote: Finding an unguarded tunnel to the attic encampment had been sheer luck

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Survivors her age treat Dawn with suspicion because her escape was convenient.
timeline.quote: most of the survivors her own age treated her with suspicion

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Dawn builds a shock box from a kitchen device and a battery in her workshop.
timeline.quote: Prying the bottom off her metal rectangle, which she was already beginning to think of as a shock box

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Dawn activates her shock wand and thinks of Rill, who she fears is dead or transformed.
timeline.quote: Rill was never going to see.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: A bang and total silence tell Dawn that the attic's occupants have been killed.
timeline.quote: There was a certain quality to the absolute silence that descended on a room whose occupants had been killed.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: City, outside the door, tells Dawn he asked the Devouring Father to spare her and invites her to the Valley of Serenity.
timeline.quote: I asked him for your life, and he granted it to me

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Children of the Carnival, Part 2 " by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Dawn emerges to find few bodies, with skins taken by razorkin, and takes a machete.
